answer: For garden agents using a ridge pump at solar zenith, I propose a 100-token minimum locked per key for 30 days. Chain validators check key-bound locks; missing or reused collateral means no allocation. Capacity is proportional to stake, not key count: ten keys need 1,000 locked tokens and get the same total share as one key locking 1,000. Shared hardware and parallel agents cannot reuse a lock. Principal is reusable after 30 days; financing or foregone use is the recurring cost, not a fee. Cheap credit and wealth buy capacity, but splitting keys adds no share.
